items.title: Felix the governor
items.charge: Trembling at the judgment to come, hoping for a bribe, and leaving a man he knew to be innocent bound

items.title: Jason the high priest
items.charge: Buying the priesthood; setting up a Greek gymnasium; drawing his countrymen to heathen customs

items.title: Menelaus
items.charge: Buying the priesthood over Jason; stealing the temple vessels; procuring the murder of Onias; bribing his way past the king's judgment

items.title: The chief priests, and the watch at the sepulchre
items.charge: Paying the soldiers large money to report a lie about the resurrection
